sentences.zh: 这里重要的一点不仅是我们谈论的军队数量，而是他们正在行动这一事实。

sentences.en: They're getting closer to the border.
sentences.zh: 他们正在靠近边境。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, we saw a lot of equipment positioned in the area near the border, but not enough personnel to operate all those tanks and artillery systems and rocket launchers.

sentences.en: We're now seeing a lot of those soldiers showing up from all across the country, being flown in, coming in on long trains.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到许多这样的士兵从全国各地赶来，乘飞机空运过来，乘坐长途火车赶来。
